blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Clustering faces by identity in long, continuous video streams is a challenging task that serves as a building block for human-centric video analysis. The majority of existing face clustering models are offline, i.e., they assume the entire data to be available altogether. In many practical scenarios, however, the entire data is either unavailable or poses computational challenges to be processed in its entirety. A handful of online methods that exist rely on geometric visual features and simple thresholding techniques, which fail when the faces exhibit significant appearance variations in long, unconstrained videos. To this end, we present VISTA, the first vision language framework for online face clustering in long videos. VISTA leverages semantic reasoning in a controlled, uncertainty aware fashion to maintain both high cluster purity and long range identity continuity. This makes it robust to the variations in illumination, pose, and costume changes that the faces and characters exhibit in long real world videos. Extensive experiments on the VPCD benchmark dataset (with 15 full episodes from The Big Bang Theory [2007-2019], Buffy the Vampire Slayer [1997-2003], and Sherlock [2010-2017]) demonstrate that VISTA achieves a robust precision and recall balance, consistently improving over the strongest matched online unsupervised baseline (COFC) under identical detector, embeddings, and evaluation protocol. Code and supplementary material: https://github.com/SkyJiashu/VISTA.
blocks.zh: 将面孔按身份排列在长而连续的视频流中是一项具有挑战性的任务,是以人为本的视频分析的基石。 大多数现有的面团模型都是离线的,即它们假设整个数据是完全可用的. 然而,在许多实际情景中,整个数据要么无法获得,要么构成需要全部处理的计算挑战。 少数存在的在线方法依赖于几何视觉特征和简单的阈值技术,当面部在长长的,不受约束的视频中表现出显著的外观变化时,这些技术就会失败. 为此,我们提出VISTA,这是在线面团在长视频中的首个视觉语言框架. VISTA以可控,不确定性意识的方式利用语义推理,既保持高集群纯度,又保持远程身份连续性. 这使得它能够坚固地适应真实世界中长长的视频中展现的光线、姿势和服装的变化。 VPCD基准数据集的广泛实验(从"大爆炸理论"[2007-2019],"吸血鬼屠夫"[1997-2003],"夏洛克"[2010-2017])表明,VISTA在相同的探测器,嵌入,以及评价协议下,实现了强大的精度和召回平衡,比最强匹配的在线无监督基线(COFC)持续改善. 代码和补充材料:https://github.com/SkyJiashu/VISTA.

blocks.en: The explosive growth of long form video content demands robust algorithms to facilitate a number of human centric video understanding tasks ( Wu and Krähenbühl, 2021 ) , such as automated character identification and narrative analysis ( Somandepalli et al., 2021 ; Brown et al., 2021 ; Haurilet et al., 2016 ) and personalised video browsing ( Khurshid et al., 2025 ) . At the core of these applications lies video face clustering i.e., grouping faces detected over a video stream based on identity, where each face cluster represents a unique person. The majority of existing video face clustering methods are offline methods i.e., they process all data points simultaneously through global optimization ( Brown et al., 2021 ; Tapaswi et al., 2019 ; Walawalkar and Garrido, 2024 ) ; however, the scale of modern video streams demands online, single pass processing algorithms that can maintain low clustering latency and remain compatible with streaming.
blocks.zh: 长形式视频内容的爆炸性增长需要强大的算法来方便一些人类核心视频理解任务(Wu和Krähenbühl,2021),如自动化字符识别和叙事分析(Somandepalli等人,2021年;Brown等人,2021年;Haurilet等人,2016年)和个性化视频浏览(Khurshid等人,2025年). 这些应用程序的核心在于视频面团,即基于身份的视频流中检测到的分组面团,每个面团代表一个独特的人. 现存的视频面团方法大多是离线方法,即通过全球优化同时处理所有数据点(Brown等人,2021年;Tapaswi等人,2019年;Walawalkar和Garrido,2024年);然而,现代视频流的规模要求在线,单传处理算法,可以保持低组群的延迟,并保持与流团兼容.

blocks.en: Strictly online face clustering algorithms are scarce in the literature due to the constraints of single pass, low latency processing. To the best of our knowledge, Constrained Online Face Clustering (COFC) ( Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2018 ) remains the state of the art for online, unsupervised face clustering. It operates by generating them incrementally using geometric embeddings (e.g., FaceNet ( Schroff et al., 2015 ) ) and spatio temporal must link/cannot link constraints. Despite the efficiency, such pure visual methods fail under extreme variations in pose and illumination, thereby often confusing identities. Several works have attempted to address this via improved face representations ( Deng et al., 2019 ) or graph based linkage technique ( Wang et al., 2019 ) , but the fundamental limitation is still relying solely on visual face similarity.
blocks.zh: 严格在线面团算法在文献中由于单传,低潜处理的限制而稀缺. 据我们所知,Constract Online Face Crouping(COFC)(Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2018)仍然是在线,无监督的面团的艺术状态. 它利用几何嵌入(例如FaceNet(Schroff等人,2015年))和spatio Time必须链接/不能链接约束来逐渐生成它们。 尽管效率很高,但这种纯粹的视觉方法在姿势和照明的极端变化下失败,从而往往混淆身份. 有几部作品试图通过改进面部表情(Deng et al., 2019)或基于图表的关联技术(Wang et al., 2019)来解决这个问题,但根本的局限性仍然完全依赖于视觉面部相似性.

blocks.en: Recently, Vision Language Models (VLMs) like CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) have been successful in improving offline clustering ( Shen et al., 2023 ) by extracting zero shot attributes (e.g., gender, age, clothing). However, applying VLM attributes directly as hard constraints introduces a critical prediction instability problem; i.e., in unconstrained videos, large variation in illumination causes VLM ‘hallucinations’ ( Li et al., 2023b ) (e.g., a red jacket identified as black in the dark) ( Shen et al., 2023 ) . Furthermore, as characters in long videos frequently change costumes, hard constraints based on hair or clothing will force the algorithm to reject valid faces. Because continuous temporal sequences are broken when intermediate faces are rejected, this leads to the artificial fragmentation of face trajectories. This over segmentation artificially inflates Weighted Cluster Purity (WCP) while degrading global identification accuracy ( Grundmann et al., 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近,Vision Language Models(VLMs)如CLIP(Radford等人,2021年)通过提取零镜头属性(如性别,年龄,服装),成功改进了离线集群(Shen等人,2023年). 然而,直接应用VLM属性,因为硬约束带来了一个关键的预测不稳定性问题;即,在不受约束的视频中,光线的较大变化导致了VLM ' hallucinations(Li等人,2023年b) (例如,在黑暗中识别为黑色的红色夹克)(Shen等人,2023年). 此外,由于长视频中的人物经常更换服装,基于头发或服装的硬约束会迫使算法拒绝有效的面孔. 因为连续时间序列在中间面被拒绝时会断裂,这导致了面部轨迹的人工分裂. 这种过度分化人为地夸大了重聚纯度(WCP),同时降低了全球识别准确度(Grundmann等人,2010年)。

blocks.en:
The basic idea of online face clustering is to group face tracks based on identity by processing short video segments (1 sec) as they come. If an identity has already been discovered, the new face track will be merged with that cluster, otherwise, a new cluster will be formed considering a ’new’ identity. To harness VLM reasoning within this paradigm (without falling into the over segmentation trap), we propose the Vision language Integrated Semantic Triage Architecture ( VISTA ). VISTA operates as a fully unsupervised, online clustering pipeline enriched by three semantic modules. (1) First, we introduce the idea of Symbolic Semantic Representation : Instead of comparing raw VLM predictions, SSR maps noisy coarse age attributes (e.g., oscillating age predictions like "20-29" vs. "30-39") to a compact set of stable discrete tokens (e.g., <age_adult> ) via a predefined deterministic mapping table (which we term a symbol registry ), acting as a temporal denoising layer. (2) We propose a three zone semantic triage mechanism to improve clustering accuracy for the difficult samples. By maintaining a sliding window of the most recent 150 geometric similarity scores between track cluster pairs, we dynamically fit a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) ( Reynolds, 2009 ) to partition these track to cluster association candidates into three zones: high confidence (merge), reject, and ambiguity zone. The ambiguity zone requires VLM arbitration. (3) To resolve the ambiguity we introduce spatio temporal decoupled semantic arbitration . VISTA decouples attributes into persistent (gender, age) and transient (clothing, hair) attributes. By applying a low confidence semantic masking mechanism during poor illumination to filter out VLM hallucinations, and a temporal decay for transient attributes across long temporal gaps (bypassing costume changes), VISTA achieves more robust global identity tracking. To summarise, our main contributions are: • We present VISTA, an online vision language framework that fuses geometric embeddings with zero shot semantic attributes. By designing the semantic integration to be lightweight, our core clustering module operates at over 1800 FPS (clustering module only; the end to end pipeline including detection and feature extraction runs at 7–8 FPS, Section 4.6 ), closing the semantic gap between low level geometric features and human interpretable identity without compromising online efficiency. • We introduce the idea of a Symbolic Semantic Representation and a Three Zone Semantic Triage scheme with GMM based dynamic thresholding to adapt to the high temporal variability in facial/personal attributes in long videos. Since COFC is already online and unsupervised, the novelty of VISTA lies specifically in this selective online semantic control layer. • We identify and address the VLM induced over segmentation
problem through a spatio temporal decoupled semantic arbitration
strategy. Rather than naively enforcing semantic constraints, VISTA
uses semantics selectively to reduce cross identity confusion while
maintaining a favorable trade off between cluster purity and
identity completeness across challenging long video benchmarks.

(1) 首先,我们提出符号语义代表的概念: SSR没有比较原始的VLM预测,而是将吵闹的粗龄属性(如"20-29"对"30-39"的斜龄预测)与紧凑的一组稳定的离散符号(如<age_adult>)进行对比. 通过一个预先定义的确定性映射表(我们称之为符号注册),作为时间解密层。 (2)我们提出三区语义分解机制,提高困难样品的集群精度. 通过维持轨道集群对之间最近150个几何相似分数的滑动窗口,我们动态地将高斯混合模型(GMM)(Reynolds,2009年)将这些轨道分割为集群关联候选人,分为三个区:高度信任(出现)、拒绝和模糊区。 模糊区需要VLM仲裁. blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Face and person clustering in videos
blocks.zh: 视频中的面部和人物组合

blocks.en: Video face clustering has traditionally been framed as an offline task. Standard approaches extract deep CNN features and perform global optimization such as graph linkage ( Zhang et al., 2016 ) or test time finetuning ( Tapaswi et al., 2019 ) . Beyond pure face features, person level representations incorporating body and clothing cues have been explored to disambiguate visually similar faces ( Sharma et al., 2019 ) . Sarfraz et al. proposed FINCH ( Sarfraz et al., 2019 ) , a parameter free first nearest neighbour clustering method that achieves competitive results with pre trained features. Building on this, Kalogeiton and Zisserman introduced C1C ( Kalogeiton and Zisserman, 2020 ) , which combines first nearest neighbour clustering with spatio temporal cannot link constraints derived from the video structure, improving cluster purity. For streaming scenarios, Kulshreshtha et al. proposed COFC ( Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2018 ) , utilizing temporal overlap within shots as a strict cannot link constraint ( Q Q matrix) to guide incremental updates; this online face clustering paradigm was later extended to construct dynamic character graphs for movie analysis ( Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2020 ) . Supervised methods such as Ball Cluster Learning (BCL) ( Tapaswi et al., 2019 ) learn to map features into pre defined metric balls; on the VPCD benchmark, BCL results are reported under the AT (unknown number of clusters) and OC (oracle number of clusters) protocols ( Brown et al., 2021 ) , and BCL is neither unsupervised nor streaming. Multi modal approaches like MuHPC ( Brown et al., 2021 ) hierarchically fuse face, voice, and body features to bridge otherwise unmergeable clusters, achieving strong offline results on the VPCD benchmark but remaining inherently offline and requiring multiple modalities. More recently, VideoClusterNet ( Walawalkar and Garrido, 2024 ) proposed self supervised refinement of face embeddings during inference, but requires multiple passes over the data. Because recent advancements have predominantly focused on offline or supervised paradigms, COFC ( Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2018 ) remains the most representative baseline for fully online, unsupervised settings. We note that existing offline methods cannot be trivially adapted to online settings: MuHPC requires global hierarchical merging across the full dataset, VideoClusterNet performs multi pass self supervised refinement, and C1C relies on a complete first-nearest-neighbour graph, all fundamentally requiring full data access. VISTA builds upon this online tracking paradigm but expands its inter shot capability by incorporating dynamic semantic triage while remaining fully unsupervised and single pass.
blocks.zh: 视频面部组合传统上被设定为离线任务. 标准方法提取深层CNN功能,并进行图链接(Zhang等人,2016年)或测试时间微调(Tapaswi等人,2019年)等全球优化. 除了纯粹的面部特征外,还探索了包含身体和服装提示的人物层面的表述,以区分视觉上相似的面孔(Sharma等人,2019年)。 Sarfraz等人提出了FINCH(Sarfraz等人,2019年),这是一种参数自由的第一近邻集成方法,以预先训练过的特性实现竞争结果. 在此基础上,卡洛盖顿和齐瑟曼引入了C1C(Kologeiton和齐瑟曼,2020年),结合了第一近邻集成与斯皮提奥时间无法连接从视频结构中衍生出来的制约,提高了集群纯度. 对于流化情景,Kulshreshtha等人提出了COFC(Kulshreshtha和Guha,2018年),将镜头内的时间重叠作为严格的无法链接约束(Q 矩阵)来指导递增更新;这一在线面团组合范式后来被扩展为构建动态字符图用于电影分析(Kulshreshtha和Guha,2020年). Ball Cluster Learning(BCL)(Tapaswi等人,2019年)等监督方法学习将特征映射到预先定义的度量球中;在VPCD基准上,BCL结果在AT(未知的集群数)和OC(oracle number of cluster)协议(Brown等人,2021年)下报告,BCL既不是无监督的,也不是流线的. 采用MuHPC(Brown等人,2021年)等多式方法,分级引信面、语音和机体特征,以连接否则无法合并的集群,在VPCD基准上取得强有力的离线成果,但内在离线,需要多种模式。 最近,VideoClusterNet(Walawalkar和Garrido,2024年)提议在推论中自行监督完善面部嵌入,但需要多次通过数据. 由于近期的进步主要集中在离线或受监督的范式上,COFC(Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2018)仍然是完全在线,不受监督的设置最具代表性的基线. 我们注意到,现有的离线方法不能勉强适应在线设置: MuHPC要求全数据集实行全局分级合并,VideoClusterNet进行多通过自我监督的完善,C1C依赖于完整的第一近邻图,所有图都从根本上要求完全的数据访问. VISTA基于这一在线跟踪范式,但通过纳入动态语义分类,同时保持完全不受监督的单次通过,来扩展其跨镜头能力.

blocks.en: VLMs for long video understanding
blocks.zh: 用于长视频理解的VLM

blocks.en: The advent of VLMs like CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) has revolutionized zero shot video understanding. For face analysis, Shen et al. introduced CLIP-Cluster ( Shen et al., 2023 ) , showing that VLMs can extract semantic attributes to assist in face grouping. Subsequent large scale vision language models such as BLIP2 ( Li et al., 2023a ) and LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2024 ) further improved zero shot recognition capabilities, enabling richer attribute extraction from video frames. However, VLM outputs are susceptible to motion blur and illumination drops in the wild. DeepFace ( Serengil and Ozpinar, 2024 ) offers a complementary source of demographic predictions but similarly degrades under low image quality. Earlier attempts at naming TV characters also leveraged multimodal cues from subtitles and dialog ( Haurilet et al., 2016 ) , yet these require structured metadata not always available in general video streams. VISTA repurposes VLM predictions as a source of symbolic supervision, employing a spatio temporal decoupling mechanism to dynamically penalize or ignore semantic contradictions based on environmental context, thereby bridging the gap between powerful zero shot capabilities and the practical instability of real world deployment.
blocks.zh: CLIP(Radford等人,2021年)等VLM的出现使零镜头视频理解发生了革命性的变化. 对于面部分析,沈等人引入了CLIP-Cluster(Shen等人,2023年),表明VLMs可以提取语义属性以协助面部分组. 随后的大型视觉语言模型如BLIP2(Li等人,2023a)和LLaVA(Liu等人,2024)进一步提高了零镜头识别能力,使得从视频帧中提取的属性更为丰富. 然而,VLM的输出容易发生运动模糊和野外的照明下降. DeepFace(Serengil和Ozpinar,2024年)是人口预测的补充来源,但同样在低影像质量下退化. 先前试图为电视人物命名, 也利用字幕和对话的多模式提示(Haurilet等人, 2016年), VISTA重新将VLM预测作为象征性监督的源头,使用时空脱钩机制来动态惩罚或忽略基于环境背景的语义矛盾,从而弥合强大的零射能力与现实世界部署的实际不稳定之间的差距.

blocks.en: 3. Methodology
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: The VISTA framework processes streaming video through three cascaded stages: (1) Feature Extraction, (2) Intra Shot Tracking, and (3) Inter Shot Semantic Association. Figure 1 illustrates the overall pipeline. Pseudocode for the complete online clustering procedure is provided in the Supplementary Material. Geometric embeddings and CLIP/DeepFace attributes are extracted up front for every face crop in Stage 1; triage controls only how often semantic arbitration fires (Section 3.3).

blocks.en: 3.1. Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1. 问题的提出

blocks.en: Given a continuous video stream 𝒱 = { f 1 , f 2 , … } \mathcal{V}=\{f_{1},f_{2},\ldots\} , we detect face instances and seek to assign each detection to an identity cluster in an online fashion, without revisiting past frames. Let 𝒟 t = { d 1 t , d 2 t , … } \mathcal{D}_{t}=\{d_{1}^{t},d_{2}^{t},\ldots\} denote detected faces at frame t t , each associated with a geometric embedding v ∈ ℝ 512 v\in\mathbb{R}^{512} and a set of raw attribute predictions 𝒜 = { a gender , a age , a clothing , a hair } \mathcal{A}=\{a_{\text{gender}},a_{\text{age}},a_{\text{clothing}},a_{\text{hair}}\} . The goal is to maintain a set of global identity clusters 𝒞 = { C 1 , C 2 , … , C K } \mathcal{C}=\{C_{1},C_{2},\ldots,C_{K}\} where K K is unknown and grows dynamically. Each incoming face track must be either merged into an existing cluster or instantiated as a new identity, using only information available up to the current time step.

blocks.en: 3.2. Feature Extraction and Intra Shot Tracking
blocks.zh: 3.2. 地物提取和内射跟踪

blocks.en: Faces are detected using RetinaFace ( Deng et al., 2020 ) and represented via FaceNet ( Schroff et al., 2015 ) embeddings. While our architecture is modular and supports alternative backends (e.g., InsightFace ( Guo et al., 2021 ) ), we employ this specific setup by default to maintain a strict, fair comparison with classical online baselines like COFC. Within a camera shot, we construct short term face tracks T T based on bounding box IoU and L 2 L_{2} feature distance. Specifically, a detection d i t d_{i}^{t} is appended to an existing track T j T_{j} if IoU ​ ( d i t , d j t − 1 ) > θ iou \text{IoU}(d_{i}^{t},d_{j}^{t-1})>\theta_{\text{iou}} and ‖ v i t − v ¯ j ‖ 2 < θ feat \|v_{i}^{t}-\bar{v}_{j}\|_{2}<\theta_{\text{feat}} , where v ¯ j \bar{v}_{j} is the running average embedding of T j T_{j} . Each track accumulates up to L max L_{\text{max}} frames (default 24) to form a stable representation. To enforce physical realism, we construct a temporal constraint matrix Q Q . If two tracks co-occur in the same frame, Q A , B = 0 Q_{A,B}=0 (cannot link constraint); otherwise Q A , B = 1 Q_{A,B}=1 .

blocks.en: Applying raw VLM textual predictions (e.g., ‘Age: 20-29’) directly is fragile due to frame level noise. VISTA defines a Symbol Registry, consisting of deterministic mapping functions ϕ d : L d → S d \phi_{d}:L_{d}\rightarrow S_{d} that convert coarse age grouping labels into discrete symbols. For example, both ‘Age: 20-29’ and ‘Age: 30-39’ map to the symbol <age_adult> , absorbing boundary oscillations. We define four attribute dimensions d ∈ { gender , age , clothing , hair } d\in\{\text{gender},\text{age},\text{clothing},\text{hair}\} , each with a compact symbol vocabulary | S d | ∈ { 2 , 5 , 7 , 5 } |S_{d}|\in\{2,5,7,5\} respectively. The exact mapping schemes and an empirical comparison between different age symbol configurations are provided in the Supplementary Material. Overall, the coarse grouping used in our unified setting provides a robust compromise across datasets by reducing boundary oscillation while retaining more discriminative power than broader adult collapsing.

blocks.en: Three zone triage with GMM dynamic thresholding
blocks.zh: 3个带GMM动态阈值的区划

blocks.en: To evaluate a merge between a query track T T and a global cluster C C , we compute the cosine similarity sim ⁡ ( v T , v C ) \mathrm{sim}(v_{T},v_{C}) . Using thresholds τ high \tau_{\text{high}} and τ low \tau_{\text{low}} , VISTA triages pairs into three zones, each activating a different mode of semantic arbitration: (1) High confidence zone ( sim > τ high \mathrm{sim}>\tau_{\text{high}} ): merge is accepted; semantic cues contribute bonus only adjustments (no penalties) to reinforce the decision; (2) Ambiguity zone ( τ low ≤ sim ≤ τ high \tau_{\text{low}}\leq\mathrm{sim}\leq\tau_{\text{high}} ): full semantic arbitration with both rewards and penalties; (3) Reject zone ( sim < τ low \mathrm{sim}<\tau_{\text{low}} ): merge is rejected by default, but a rescue mechanism can override the rejection when persistent semantic cues (gender + age) strongly agree.

blocks.en: Rather than relying exclusively on static boundaries, VISTA maintains a sliding window queue 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} of recent similarity scores and fits a bimodal Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) online to capture the distribution of same identity and different identity pairs. During the initial warm up phase (i.e., before 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} is fully populated), the system relies on static initial thresholds τ high ( 0 ) \tau_{\text{high}}^{(0)} and τ low ( 0 ) \tau_{\text{low}}^{(0)} . The sensitivity of these initial parameters is extensively evaluated in the Supplementary Material. The GMM is formalized as: (2) p ⁡ ( x ) = π 1 ​ 𝒩 ​ ( x ∣ μ 1 , σ 1 2 ) + π 2 ​ 𝒩 ​ ( x ∣ μ 2 , σ 2 2 ) , p(x)=\pi_{1}\mathcal{N}(x\mid\mu_{1},\sigma_{1}^{2})+\pi_{2}\mathcal{N}(x\mid\mu_{2},\sigma_{2}^{2}), where the lower component ( μ 1 < μ 2 \mu_{1}<\mu_{2} ) models different identity similarities and the upper component models same identity similarities. We dynamically estimate the threshold proposals as (3) τ low ⋆ = clip ⁡ ( μ 1 + σ 1 , 0.15 , 0.50 ) , τ high ⋆ = μ 2 − 0.5 ​ σ 2 . \tau_{\text{low}}^{\star}=\mathrm{clip}(\mu_{1}+\sigma_{1},\,0.15,\,0.50),\qquad\tau_{\text{high}}^{\star}=\mu_{2}-0.5\sigma_{2}. The 0.50 0.50 cap on τ low ⋆ \tau_{\text{low}}^{\star} is a deliberate design choice: it preserves a sufficiently wide ambiguity zone for semantic arbitration in visually compressed windows. A cap sweep over all 15 episodes (Supplementary Material) shows that relaxing it to 0.70 0.70 or 1.00 1.00 leaves all metrics unchanged after rounding, i.e., it is a stability safeguard rather than a tuned knob. To ensure temporal stability, we apply an exponential moving average update ( Tarvainen and Valpola, 2017 ) : (4) τ new = η gmm ​ τ ⋆ + ( 1 − η gmm ) ​ τ old , \tau_{\text{new}}=\eta_{\text{gmm}}\tau^{\star}+(1-\eta_{\text{gmm}})\tau_{\text{old}}, where η gmm = 0.3 \eta_{\text{gmm}}=0.3 is the GMM threshold smoothing coefficient, distinct from the cluster representation momentum ema_rep (Section 4.2 ). This mechanism allows VISTA to adapt to evolving visual distributions across different scenes while preventing abrupt threshold oscillations. An empirical visualization confirming the bimodal structure of the similarity distributions across all 15 episodes is provided in the Supplementary Material.

blocks.en: 4. Experiments
blocks.zh: 4. 实验

blocks.en: 4.1. Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1. 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate on the VPCD benchmarks: TBBT (6 episodes, well lit sitcom), Sherlock (3 episodes, thriller with costume changes), and Buffy (6 episodes, dark action, which feature rich narrative and character arcs ( Kaveney, 2004 ) ). We report Weighted Cluster Purity (WCP) , Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) , and Identification Accuracy (ID_Acc) . WCP focuses on cluster homogeneity, while ID_Acc penalizes trajectory fragmentation. VISTA seeks a favorable balance across these metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们根据VPCD的基准来评价:TBBT(6集,好点的情景喜剧),夏洛克(3集,带有服装变化的惊悚片),以及Buffy(6集,黑暗动作,其中包含丰富的叙事和人物弧(Kavney,2004年)). 我们报告加权集群净化(WCP),规范的相互信息(NMI),以及识别准确性(ID_Acc). WCP专注于集群同质性,而ID_Acc则惩罚轨迹分裂. VISTA寻求在这些指标之间取得有利的平衡。

blocks.zh: 4.2. 实施细节

blocks.en: VISTA is implemented in Python using PyTorch. As described in Section 3.2, we utilize RetinaFace ( Deng et al., 2020 ) for face detection and FaceNet ( Schroff et al., 2015 ) for identity embedding. CLIP ViT-B/32 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) performs zero shot attribute classification with text prompts for clothing and hair, and DeepFace ( Serengil and Ozpinar, 2024 ) is used for age analysis. The complete CLIP text prompt templates, label vocabularies, and the full Symbol Registry mappings are provided in the Supplementary Material.

blocks.en: 4.3. Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.3. 量化结果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports a controlled comparison between VISTA and COFC under identical detector, embeddings, and protocol, together with literature reported results as reference points. We note that strictly online unsupervised face clustering methods are rare; COFC ( Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2018 ) remains the only published method in this category with results on VPCD. We additionally include offline unsupervised (C1C ( Kalogeiton and Zisserman, 2020 ) ), supervised (BCL ( Tapaswi et al., 2019 ) ), and multi-modal (MuHPC ( Brown et al., 2021 ) ) methods as reference points. Methods marked with † \dagger use SENet-50 features, which are generally more discriminative than the FaceNet embeddings used by VISTA and COFC ( Deng et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 表1报告在相同的探测器、嵌入和协议下对VISTA和COFC进行对照比较,以及报告结果的文献作为参考点。 我们注意到,严格在线无监督的面部集群方法非常罕见;COFC(Kulshreshtha and Guha, 2018)仍然是该类中唯一公布的方法,在VPCD上有结果. 此外,我们还包括离线无监督方法(C1C(Kalogeiton和Zisserman,2020年))、监督方法(BCL(Tapaswi等人,2019年))和多模式方法(MuHPC(Brown等人,2021年))作为参考点。 标有 \\dagger 的方法使用 SENet- 50 特性,这些特性一般比 VITA 和 COFC 使用的 FaceNet 嵌入式(Deng 等人, 2019年)更具有歧视性.

blocks.en: VISTA outperforms COFC across all three datasets under identical features and evaluation. On TBBT , WCP and NMI improve from 92.13 % 92.13\% / 86.97 % 86.97\% to 96.97 % 96.97\% / 91.25 % 91.25\% , and ID_Acc from 89.74 % 89.74\% to 93.94 % 93.94\% . On Buffy , VISTA raises WCP and NMI from 64.60 % 64.60\% / 66.28 % 66.28\% to 87.39 % 87.39\% / 79.30 % 79.30\% , with ID_Acc improving from 64.31 % 64.31\% to 82.82 % 82.82\% ( + 18.51 +18.51 pp), also far surpassing the offline C1C ( 66.30 % 66.30\% / 68.80 % 68.80\% ) that uses stronger features. As literature reference points, VISTA’s TBBT results ( 96.97 % 96.97\% / 91.25 % 91.25\% ) are also higher than the reported supervised BCL (AT) numbers ( 90.80 % 90.80\% / 85.70 % 85.70\% ), and its Buffy NMI is comparable ( 79.30 % 79.30\% vs. 78.80 % 78.80\% ), although feature and protocol differences preclude a strict comparison.

On Sherlock , VISTA improves over both COFC ( 76.22 % 76.22\% / 50.56 % 50.56\% ) and C1C ( 76.30 % 76.30\% / 50.30 % 50.30\% ), reaching 80.45 % 80.45\% / 51.19 % 51.19\% . However, ID_Acc decreases from 71.27 % 71.27\% (COFC) to 68.10 % 68.10\% ( − 3.17 -3.17 pp): under Sherlock ’s heavy disguises and long gap appearance variation, VISTA prioritises cluster purity over identity continuity, yielding cleaner clusters at the cost of additional fragmentation. We regard this as a limitation rather than a universal all metric gain; Sections 4.4 and 4.5 analyse this purity–continuity trade off in detail. Although the gains are more modest than on TBBT and Buffy , this confirms that selective semantic integration provides consistent WCP/NMI improvements even on the most volatile dataset, with room for future refinement.
blocks.zh: 在夏洛克上,VISTA的改进范围分别是COFC(76.22% 76.22% 50.56% 50.56 % ) 和C1C(76.30% 76.30 % 50.30 % 50.30 % 50.30 % ), 达到80.45% / 51.19% 51.19 % 。 然而, ID_Acc从71.27% 71.27 % (COFC) 降至68.10% 68.10 % (− 3.17 - 3.17页): 在夏洛克的沉重伪装和长空隙外观变异下,VISTA将集群纯度置于身份连续性之上,以额外的破碎成本产生清洁集群。 我们认为这是一个限制,而不是所有衡量标准的普遍收益;第4.4节和第4.5节详细分析了这种纯度-持续交易。 虽然比TBBT和Buffy的收益要小,但这证实选择性语义集成即使在最不稳定的数据集上也提供一致的WCP/NMI改进,还有未来改进的余地.

blocks.en: To isolate the source of the gains, we evaluate two further online baselines under the same features and protocol (full tables in the Supplementary Material). (i) Naive VLM hard constraints : raw attributes applied as must link/cannot link rules (no SSR, no triage) over fragment severely, producing 4.0 4.0 – 11.3 × 11.3\times more clusters than ground truth; the inflated cluster count artificially raises WCP while ID_Acc collapses to 63.95 63.95 / 60.64 60.64 / 40.65 40.65 on TBBT / Buffy / Sherlock , far below VISTA Full and below our weakest geometry driven ablation (Table 2 ). This confirms that VISTA’s improvements stem from selective semantic triage , not from VLM attributes alone. (ii) Sequential online HAC attains very high WCP ( 99.73 99.73 / 97.62 97.62 / 91.19 91.19 ) under severe fragmentation (#Pred/#GT = 4.5 =4.5 / 9.5 9.5 / 39.8 × 39.8\times ) but substantially lower NMI/ID_Acc ( 84.93 84.93 / 81.29 81.29 , 76.78 76.78 / 63.49 63.49 , 49.28 49.28 / 40.56 40.56 ), illustrating the over segmentation trap that three zone triage is designed to avoid.

(二)在严重碎裂(#Pred/#GT=4.5=4.5=9.5=39.8×39.8\时间)下,序线在线HAC获得极高的WCP(99.73 99.73/97.62 97.62/91.19),但大幅降低NMI/ID_Acc(84.93 84.93/ 81.29 81.29,76.78 63.49 63.49, 49.28 49.28/40.56/40.56),说明三个区划是为了避免的超分圈.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , disabling Semantic Arbitration or SSR degrades performance (especially on TBBT ), confirming that geometric similarity alone struggles with appearance variations and that SSR is vital for stabilizing noisy predictions. Similarly, removing Three Zone Gating or Temporal Smoothing weakens the precision recall trade off, leading to brittle merges. Interestingly, on the volatile Sherlock dataset, some ablated variants achieve higher individual metric scores. In particular, removing Temporal Smoothing raises WCP to 84.11 % 84.11\% (vs. 80.45 % 80.45\% ). We attribute this to Sherlock’s frequent costume changes and disguises: temporal smoothing carries stale transient attribute profiles into subsequent decisions, occasionally penalising valid same identity merges. Conversely, removing SSR yields a higher NMI ( 52.62 % 52.62\% ) and ID_Acc ( 71.43 % 71.43\% ) but at the cost of lower WCP ( 78.36 % 78.36\% ), reflecting the fundamental purity completeness trade off. This dataset specific tension motivates future work on adaptive smoothing decay rates.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,瘫痪语义仲裁或SSR会降低性能(特别是在TBBT上),证实几何相似性本身就与外观变化有冲突,SSR对于稳定噪音预测至关重要。 同样,删除“三区定位”或“临时” 平滑会削弱精确的召回交换,导致微弱的合并. 有趣的是,在波动的夏洛克数据集上,一些被淡化的变体实现了更高的单个度量分数. 特别是,消除温带平滑将WCP提升到84.11 % (vs 80.45 % ) 。 我们将此归咎于夏洛克频繁的服饰改变和伪装:时间平滑会带去沉闷的瞬间属性描述,有时会惩罚有效的同一身份合并。 反之,去除SSR则产生更高的NMI(52.62% 52.62\%)和ID_Acc(71.43% 71.43\%),但代价是较低的WCP(78.36% 78.36\%),反映了基本的纯度完整性交易. 这个数据集特定的张力激发了未来适应性平滑衰变速率的工作.

blocks.en: 4.5. Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5. 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 3 and the crop level comparison in the Supplementary Material provide qualitative comparisons on Sherlock , the most challenging dataset. These visualizations reveal that the main failure mode of classical online clustering is not uniform: some characters primarily suffer from cross identity confusion, while others are more affected by trajectory fragmentation.
blocks.zh: 图3和补充材料中的作物水平比较提供了对最具有挑战性的数据集夏洛克的质量比较。 这些可视化揭示了古典在线集群的主要失败模式并不一致:一些角色主要受到交叉身份混淆的影响,而另一些则受到轨迹分裂的影响更大.

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows that COFC’s identity errors extend beyond local boundary noise: predicted clusters intrude into other characters’ timelines for extended intervals. A representative case is COFC’s Lestrade timeline, which contains repeated intrusions from a Mycroft dominant cluster, indicating substantial cross identity confusion rather than mere short term fragmentation. VISTA preserves cleaner separation between these visually similar but semantically distinct characters, suggesting that semantic triage prevents overly aggressive merging.
blocks.zh: 图3显示,COFC的身份差错超越了局部边界噪声:预测的集群会侵入其他字符延长间隔的时间. 一个具有代表性的案例是COFC的Lestrade时间线,该时间线包含来自Mycroft主导集群的反复入侵,表明存在重大的交叉身份混淆,而不仅仅是短期分裂。 VISTA保持了这些视觉上相似但有着明显区别的字符之间的更清洁的分离,表明语义分类可以防止过于激进的合并.

blocks.en: The crop level comparison (Supplementary Material) complements this: under challenging pose, illumination, and blur conditions, COFC more frequently assigns samples to competing clusters, whereas VISTA keeps a larger portion within identity consistent clusters. Importantly, VISTA’s remaining errors on Sherlock stem from overly conservative semantic decisions that occasionally fragment the same identity into multiple segments, rather than cross identity confusion. This is precisely the mechanism behind the ID_Acc decrease relative to COFC on Sherlock (Table 1 ): purity is defended at the cost of identity continuity. The qualitative gain is thus better understood as a shift in error profile, from large scale identity mixing toward more structured, localized fragmentation, consistent with the quantitative trends in Table 2 . This also explains why removing Temporal Smoothing can raise WCP on Sherlock : without stale attribute profiles, fewer valid merges are rejected, at the cost of reduced cross identity discrimination.
blocks.zh: 作物水平比较(补充材料)对此作了补充:在挑战性姿势、照明和模糊的条件下,COFC更经常地将样品分配给竞争的集群,而VISTA则将较大部分保留在特征一致的集群内。 重要的是,VISTA对夏洛克的其余错误来自于过于保守的语义决定,这些决定偶尔会将同一身份分割成多个部分,而不是交叉身份混淆. 这恰恰是相对于夏洛克上的COFC(表1)ID_Acc减少背后的机制: 纯度以身份连续性为代价进行辩护. 因此,质量收益被更清楚地理解为错误剖面的转变,从大规模身份混合转向与表2中的量化趋势相一致的更有条理、更局部的分散。 这也解释了为什么移除Temperal Smoothing可以提高夏洛克的WCP:没有僵硬的属性剖面图,有效的合并被拒绝,代价是减少交叉身份歧视.

blocks.en: 4.6. Computational Efficiency and Throughput
blocks.zh: 4.6. 计算效率和产出

blocks.en: A critical requirement for online clustering is computational efficiency. To demonstrate that VISTA’s semantic triage and spatio temporal arbitration do not introduce prohibitive overhead, we profile the throughput of our pipeline. As shown in Table 3 , the performance exhibits a clear dichotomy between the heavy feature extraction front end and the efficient clustering back end.
blocks.zh: 在线分组的一个关键要求是计算效率。 为了证明VISTA的语义分类和时空仲裁没有带来令人望而却步的间接费用,我们描绘了我们管道的吞吐量。 如表3所示,性能在重型特性提取前端和高效集群后端之间明显存在二分法.

blocks.en: The end to end throughput (Total FPS) stabilizes at approximately 7 to 8 frames per second. Profiling reveals that over 99% of this time is consumed by Stage 1 (Feature Extraction), which involves decoding high resolution video frames and executing dense face detection alongside multi-modal feature encoding (FaceNet, CLIP, and DeepFace attribute extraction).
blocks.zh: 终端吞吐量(Total FPS)稳定在每秒约7至8帧. 分析显示,这段时间中超过99%的时间被第一阶段(Feature Departmenton)消耗,它涉及解码高分辨率视频帧,在多模式特性编码(FaceNet、CLIP和DeepFace属性提取)的同时进行密集面孔检测。

blocks.en: In contrast, VISTA’s online clustering module (Stages 2 and 3) operates at 1800 to 2300 FPS. This highlights a major advantage of our design: by abstracting raw VLM outputs into compact SSR and employing dynamic GMM thresholding, VISTA restricts semantic arbitration to ambiguous boundary cases. Consequently, the proposed vision language integration achieves robust performance gains while keeping the online clustering phase itself efficient; in our implementation, the dominant runtime bottleneck remains face detection and feature extraction and not the clustering.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,VISTA的在线集群模块(第2和第3段)运行于1800至2300 FPS. 这突出说明了我们设计的一大优点:通过将原始的VLM输出抽象为紧凑的SSD,并采用动态的GMM阈值,VISTA将语义仲裁限制在模糊的边界案件中. 因此,拟议中的愿景语言整合在保持在线分组阶段本身效率的同时,实现了强劲的业绩收益;在我们的实施中,主要的运行时间瓶颈仍然是面临检测和特征提取,而不是分组。

blocks.en: The Spatio Temporal Semantic Triage acts as an effective decision filter (Table 4 ). Across 1.2M+ frames, semantic arbitration is invoked for only 20.50 % 20.50\% of tracklets (covering 11.64 % 11.64\% of total frames). TBBT requires the least intervention ( 9.19 % 9.19\% of frames) due to cleaner visual conditions, while Buffy ’s darker scenes trigger more ambiguity ( 13.54 % 13.54\% ). Since CLIP/DeepFace attributes are extracted up front for every crop in Stage 1 (always included in the end to end cost), Table 4 measures how often arbitration fires during association, not how many VLM forward passes are avoided; triage keeps the clustering stage lightweight by restricting arbitration to ambiguous boundary cases.
blocks.zh: 时空语义 纹理是有效的决定过滤器(表4)。 在1.2M+帧中,只有20.50%的轨道(占总帧的11.64%)被援引语义仲裁。 TBBT要求最小的干预(9.19 % 9.19 % ) , 因为视觉条件更清洁,而Buffy的黑暗场景引发了更多的模糊性(13.54% 13.54 % ) 。 由于CLIP/DeepFace属性在第一阶段(总是包括在最终成本中 ) , 表4衡量了关联期间的仲裁火灾频率,而不是避免多少VLM前传;通过将仲裁限制在模糊的边界案件中来保持集群阶段轻量。

blocks.zh: 4.7. 人口差异分析

blocks.en: (a) By Gender
blocks.zh: (a) 按性别分类

blocks.en: (b) By Age Group

blocks.en: Figure 4 . Distribution of VLM intervention and rejection rates across different demographic groups.
blocks.zh: 图4 不同人口群体中的自愿终止妊娠干预和拒绝率分布。

blocks.en: Although VISTA reduces global identity confusion, VLM arbitration is not invoked uniformly across predicted demographic groups. We therefore report both triage rate diagnostics (Figure 4 ) and subgroup clustering-quality gaps in the Supplementary Material. Female characters show higher intervention and ambiguity-zone rejection rates than male characters (13.48% vs. 10.76%, and 2.38% vs. 1.62%), suggesting that more disambiguation burden is offloaded to semantic arbitration in unconstrained settings. This observation is consistent with known gender accuracy disparities in commercial vision models ( Buolamwini and Gebru, 2018 ) , although our analysis is diagnostic rather than causal.
blocks.zh: 虽然VISTA减少了全球身份混淆,但VLM仲裁并没有在预测的人口群体中统一引用. 因此,我们报告补充材料中的分类率诊断(图4)和分组质量差距。 女性角色的干预和模糊区拒绝率高于男性角色(13.48%对10.76%,2.38%对1.62%),这表明在不受约束的环境下,更模糊不清的负担被卸载到语义仲裁中. 尽管我们的分析是诊断性的而不是因果性的,但这一观察与商业视觉模型(Buolamwini和Gebru, 2018年)中已知的性别准确性差距是一致的。

blocks.en: Age Disparities: Figure 4(b) reveals distinct effects at age extremes. Children (0–9 years) trigger the highest VLM intervention rate (24.03%), while older adults (50–59 years) face the highest rejection rate (5.93%). Conversely, the core 30–39 demographic, which is common in face model training distributions ( Kärkkäinen and Joo, 2021 ) , requires the least intervention (8.55%). These trends suggest that skewed training data and difficult capture conditions can jointly affect representation robustness for age extremes ( Suresh and Guttag, 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 年龄差异:图4(b)显示在年龄极端时的明显影响。 儿童(0至9岁)触发的VLM干预率最高(24.03%),而老年(50至59岁)的拒绝率最高(5.93%)。 相反,面对培训模式分布(Kärkkäinen和Joo,2021年)常见的核心30-39人口需要最少的干预(8.55%)。 这些趋势表明,扭曲的培训数据和困难的捕捉条件可能共同影响年龄极端现象的代表性(Suresh和Guttag,2021年)。

blocks.en: Subgroup Quality and Safeguards: Beyond triage rates, the Supplementary Material reports WCP/NMI/ID_Acc gaps on the IoU matched subset using the same VLM predicted gender/age groups. Because VPCD lacks ground truth demographics, these groups do not constitute a full fairness audit; nevertheless, the gap signs vary across datasets rather than showing one directional degradation. As an ethical safeguard, VISTA can disable gender/age cues and fall back to geometry plus transient attributes.
blocks.zh: 分组质量和保障: 除了分数率之外,补充材料还报告妇女信息中心/国家信息信息中心/国际信息中心在IoU上的差距,并使用相同的VLM预测性别/年龄组来匹配子集。 由于VPCD缺乏地面真实人口统计,这些群体并不构成全面公平审计;然而,差距迹象因数据集而异,而不是显示一个方向退化。 作为道德保障,VISTA可以禁用性别/年龄提示,回到几何特征和瞬间属性.

blocks.en: Discussion: These preliminary findings show clear algorithmic disparities, but demographic variables in videos often entangle with environmental factors. Screen industry tropes, visual ageism ( Crawford and Paglen, 2019 ; Ozimek, 2020 ; Calasanti et al., 2006 ) , and historical underrepresentation ( Smith et al., 2020 ; Bamman et al., 2024 ) often dictate lighting, camera angles, and action sequences for specific groups. For instance, low illumination scenes common in action genres can disproportionately degrade geometric feature extraction for darker skin tones, compounding existing gender and age ambiguities. Thus, attributing these disparities solely to intrinsic model bias requires further disentanglement. Future work will systematically analyze these issues by cross referencing scene level factors (illumination, pose, focal presence) with face model training distributions, while extending to the intersectional impacts of digital racialization ( Amaro, 2022 ; Sharma, 2023 ) . Addressing these entangled biases is essential for deploying equitable face clustering systems in real world, unconstrained video streaming applications.
blocks.zh: 讨论: 这些初步调查结果显示了明显的算法差异,但视频中的人口变量往往与环境因素纠缠在一起. 银幕行业的颤音,视觉年龄主义(Crawford and Paglen, 2019年;Ozimek, 2020年;Calasanti等人, 2006年),以及历史代表性不足(Smith等人, 2020年;Bamman等人, 2024年) 经常为特定群体规定照明,镜头角度,动作序列. 例如,在动作流派中常见的低照明场景会不成比例地使几何特征提取更深的皮肤色调退化,使现有的性别和年龄模糊性复杂化。 因此,将这些差异完全归因于固有的模式偏见,需要进一步分解。 未来的工作将系统地分析这些问题,方法是将场景水平因素(照明、姿势、联络)与面部培训模式分布相参照,同时扩大到数字种族化的交叉影响(Amaro, 2022;Sharma, 2023)。 解决这些缠绕在一起的偏见,对于在现实世界部署公平的面团系统、不受限制的视频流应用至关重要。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: We presented VISTA, a vision language semantic triage architecture for fully online face clustering in long videos. By combining Symbolic Semantic Representation, dynamic GMM thresholding, and spatio temporal decoupled arbitration, VISTA mitigates over segmentation and improves the purity–continuity trade off on TBBT , Buffy , and Sherlock . Under identical detector, embeddings, and evaluation protocol, VISTA consistently outperforms the strongest matched online unsupervised baseline while preserving streaming compatible efficiency. Limitations and Future Work: VISTA still relies on fixed symbolic vocabularies, a bimodal GMM prior, and approximate confidence attenuation; cross domain validation beyond scripted TV remains open. On Sherlock , VISTA trades identity continuity for purity (ID_Acc − 3.17 -3.17 pp vs. COFC), motivating adaptive smoothing, calibrated VLM uncertainty, and confounder aware fairness analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了VISTA,一种视觉语言语义分类架构,用于在长视频中完全在线化的面团. 通过将符号语义代表、动态的GMM阈值和斯皮提奥时间脱钩仲裁结合起来,VISTA缓解了分化,提高了纯度 — — TBBT、Buffy和夏洛克的连续交易。 在相同的探测器、嵌入器和评价协议下,VISTA在保持流式兼容效率的同时,一贯超越最强的匹配在线无监督基线。 限制与未来工作:VISTA仍然依赖于固定的符号词汇,一种双模式的GMM前,以及大约的信心减弱;超越脚本电视的交叉域验证仍然开放. 在夏洛克,VISTA将身份连续性作为纯度交易(ID_Acc − 3.17-3.17 pp vs. COFC),激发适应性平滑,校准VLM不确定性,以及混淆者意识的公平分析.

blocks.en: S2. VISTA Algorithm Pseudocode
blocks.zh: S2. VISTA 算法 Pseudocode

blocks.en: To provide a clearer understanding of the online clustering process, we detail the step by step execution of VISTA in Algorithm S1 . The algorithm processes the video stream in a single pass. For each camera shot, it extracts dense visual features and zero shot VLM attributes. Short term temporal tracking is performed to construct reliable local tracklets. Subsequently, the inter shot association is guided by our dynamic Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) thresholding and spatio temporal decoupled semantic arbitration. This pipeline ensures that low confidence semantic noise is filtered out while valuable temporal constraints and geometric similarities are preserved. We emphasise that geometric embeddings and CLIP/DeepFace attributes are extracted up front for every face crop at shot ingestion (line 3) and voted into tracklet level SSR profiles; the three zone triage controls only whether semantic arbitration is invoked during association, not whether VLM inference is performed. The final acceptance gate for ambiguity zone pairs is τ merge = 0.325 \tau_{\text{merge}}=0.325 (see Section 3.3 of the main paper).
blocks.zh: 为了更清楚地了解在线集群过程,我们详细介绍了在算法S1中逐步执行VISTA的情况。 该算法以单传处理视频流. 对于每个镜头,它会提取密集的视觉特征和0镜头的VLM属性. 进行短期时间跟踪以构建可靠的本地轨道。 随后,跨镜头协会以我们动态的高斯混合模型(GMM)阈值和时空脱钩语义仲裁为指导。 这一管道确保低自信的语义噪音被过滤掉,同时保留宝贵的时间限制和几何相似性。 我们强调,几何嵌入物和CLIP/DeepFace属性在镜头摄入时被提取到每个面部作物的正面(第3行),并被选入轨迹级SSR剖面图;三个区划只控制在关联期间是否援引语义仲裁,而不是是否进行VLM推论. 模棱两可区对的最后验收门为& = 0.325\ tau\ text{commer_0.325(见主纸第3.3节).

blocks.en: S3. Age Symbol Configurations
blocks.zh: S3. 年龄符号配置

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 3.3 of the main paper, applying raw VLM textual predictions directly introduces severe frame level noise. To mitigate this, VISTA maps raw age strings to a discrete vocabulary. We tested three different age grouping strategies, detailed in Table S1 .
blocks.zh: 如主论文第3.3节所述,应用原始VLM文字预测直接引入了严重的帧级噪声. 为了减轻这种情况,VISTA将原始的时代字符串映射到一个离散的词汇. 我们测试了三种不同的年龄组战略,详见表S1。

blocks.en:
The fine_grained strategy preserves decade level precision for adults, which can occasionally differentiate close identities but is highly susceptible to VLM oscillation (e.g., predicting “20-29” in one frame and “30-39” in the next). The broad_adult strategy collapses a massive 40-year span into a single token, which guarantees stability but loses discriminative power. The coarse_grouping strategy provides the most robust compromise
for the unified setting by reducing age boundary oscillation without
collapsing the entire adult range into a single token.

blocks.en: Table S3 provides the complete Symbol Registry mappings that convert raw CLIP predictions into stable symbolic tokens (SSR). blocks.en: S5. Dataset Specific Parameter Effects

blocks.en: While the main paper reports VISTA’s performance using a unified parameter setting for fair benchmarking, we present a marginal sensitivity analysis here to demonstrate the framework’s robustness across different visual environments. Tables S4 , S5 , and S6 display the marginal effects of individual hyperparameters on TBBT , Buffy , and Sherlock , respectively.

blocks.en: Overall, the standard deviation of metrics across these reasonable hyperparameter ranges remains small. We consistently observe that a higher cluster representation smoothing momentum ( ema_rep = 0.95 \texttt{ema\_rep}=0.95 ; named ema in an earlier version, distinct from the GMM threshold smoothing coefficient η gmm \eta_{\text{gmm}} ) is beneficial for preventing abrupt threshold oscillation in online scenarios. Furthermore, challenging datasets with darker scenes (e.g., Buffy ) favor a larger GMM sliding window ( queue = 300 \texttt{queue}=300 ) to gather enough diverse samples for stable threshold estimation, whereas visually stable datasets (e.g., TBBT ) can adapt faster with a smaller queue. Note that the τ high \tau_{\text{high}} spread in these tables reflects simultaneous co-variation of ema_rep and queue size; these marginal tables are not a one factor test of τ high \tau_{\text{high}} alone. A dedicated 3 × 3 3\times 3 warm up threshold grid with all other settings fixed is reported in Section S12 .

blocks.en: S6. Semantic Arbitration Invocation Rate Visualization
blocks.zh: S6. 语义仲裁援引率可视化

blocks.en: Figure S1 visually reinforces the high efficiency of VISTA, complementing the raw statistics reported in the main paper. Across all three datasets, the triage mechanism successfully limits semantic arbitration by routing the vast majority of frames ( 86.5 % 86.5\% - 90.8 % 90.8\% ) through the fast, visual only pipeline. As clarified in the main paper (Section 4.6), CLIP/DeepFace attributes are extracted up front for every face crop; these rates measure how often the arbitration step fires during association, not how many VLM forward passes are avoided. Notably, TBBT requires the least arbitration ( 9.2 % 9.2\% ), consistent with its well lit studio conditions. Conversely, Buffy triggers the highest rate ( 13.5 % 13.5\% ) due to frequent low illumination scenes and fast motion that push more track cluster pairs into the ambiguity zone. Sherlock falls between the two ( 11.4 % 11.4\% ) despite being the hardest dataset overall, suggesting that its difficulty stems more from extreme long range appearance variation (e.g., character disguises) than from persistent local visual ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 图S1从视觉上加强了VISTA的高效性,补充了主要文件中报告的原始统计数据. 在所有三个数据集中,分解机制通过快速、直观的管道将绝大多数帧(86.5%-86.5%-90.8%-90.8%)的路由线成功地限制了语义仲裁。 如主要文件(第4.6节)所述,CLIP/DeepFace属性为每个面部作物在前面抽取;这些比率衡量在结合期间仲裁步骤的火灾次数,而不是避免多少VLM前传通行证。 TBBT要求仲裁最少(9.2%), 反之,Buffy由于频繁的低照明场景和快速运动将更多轨道集群对推进到模糊区,触发了最高速率(13.5% 13.5\%). 夏洛克在两者(11.4% 11.4\%)之间跌落,尽管整体上是最难的数据集,这表明其难度更多来自极端的长距离外观变异(如人物伪装),而不是持续的局部视觉模糊.

blocks.en: Table S9 expands upon the tracklet length ablation discussed in Section 4.4 of the main paper. blocks.en: Complementing the triage rate analysis in the main paper (Section 4.7), Table S13 reports subgroup clustering quality gaps on the IoU matched face subset, using the same VLM predicted gender/age groups. VPCD provides no ground truth demographic annotations, so these figures should be read as a diagnostic rather than a full fairness audit. The signs of the gaps vary across datasets, indicating character and dataset dependent effects rather than a one directional degradation. As an ethical safeguard, our implementation provides an option to disable the gender/age attributes entirely, in which case arbitration falls back to transient cues and geometry only.
